name: Spectral Comb
summary: South of Darkshire, the Spectral Comb gathers ghost hair from Blind Mary at a ruined farmstead.

sections.title: A Tool for Restless Dead
sections.body: Ordinary combs cannot reach a spirit’s hair, so few mortal craftsmen can gather it. The Spectral Comb passes through those unseen tresses. At a ruined farmstead south of Darkshire, it is offered to Blind Mary, a weeping ghost who wails alone. Grooming brings her solace, and she willingly takes up the comb. The fibers she leaves behind can be woven into Ghost Hair Thread.

faq.q: What is the Spectral Comb used for?
aliases: why do i need spectral comb
faq.answer: You give the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary, a weeping ghost south of Darkshire. As she combs her hair, the comb gathers ethereal strands that can be spun into supernatural thread.

aliases: who is the ghost with the comb
faq.answer: Blind Mary is a tormented spirit haunting an abandoned house in the hills south of Darkshire. Driven mad by tragedy, she tore out her own eyes and fears others find her hideous in death.

faq.q: Why can an ordinary comb not be used?
faq.answer: An ordinary comb cannot touch a spirit’s intangible hair. The Spectral Comb passes through an apparition’s tresses.

angles.text: As a tailor, you can use the Spectral Comb to gather ethereal fibers from willing ghosts instead of shearing them by ordinary means.
As an Alliance traveler, you can carry the comb south of Darkshire and see the tragic fate of Duskwood’s former homesteaders.
